title: Undergraduate Academic Calendar 2026/2027
text:
English Language Proficiency Requirement
Lauriers
language of instruction is English. If your first language is not English, you
must provide evidence of your English proficiency to our Recruitment and
Admissions office.
Cambridge Assessment English
C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency: 176 overall.
Canadian Academic English Language Assessment (CAEL)
CAEL or CAEL Online: 70 overall; 60 in each band.
Duolingo English Test
Minimum score of 120.
International English Language Testing System (IELTS)
Academic
Online or In-person test score of 6.5 or higher with a
minimum of 6.0 in each band.
LanguageCert Academic
Score of 70 or higher with a minimum score of 65 in each skill.
Pearson Test of English Academic (PTE Academic)
59 overall or higher.
Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL)
Internet-based testing (TOEFL iBT or TOEFL iBT Home Edition):
Tests written prior to January 2026: an overall score of 83 or higher with a minimum score of 20 in each component.
Tests written January 2026 forward: a score of 4.5 or higher with a minimum of 4.0 in each section band.
Conestoga Colleges Intensive English Language for Academic Success
Level 4 with a satisfactory final score of 70%
Renison University Colleges English for Academic Success
Advanced level (400) with a satisfactory final score of
75%.
University of Guelphs English Language Certificate
Program
Advanced level 9 and 10 with a satisfactory final score of
75%.
